title: Scientists Analyze Modern Tennis Technique of Sliding
main_content:
Sliding to return a shot is a common tennis practice on clay courts, but lately players have started using it on grass and hard courts as well. Scientists say it is faster than running and allows athletes to change direction more quickly.

“The speed of the game has increased a lot because the players are serving faster than years before,” said Daniel Ura, a researcher in the University of Sheffield’s Department of Mechanical Engineering. “It could be because of the materials of the rackets, or could be the strings as well. But I think it’s a necessity of the players to reach the ball faster.”

So far, only a few top players have mastered the technique off-clay. For effective slides, the shoes must perfectly match the court’s surface, and this is where the science comes in handy.

“I think it will become more like a Formula 1 race probably,” Ura said, with the right shoe depending on the weather or the surface conditions.

Looking for the best match between shoes and surface, researchers at the University of Sheffield have built a special mechanical rig that can measure the shoe traction.

The research, in partnership with the International Tennis Federation, may lead to different materials for tennis shoes, different court surfaces, and ultimately faster and even more exciting tennis matches.

questions.question: Why have tennis players started sliding more?
options: A) They find it more comfortable than running.
B) It is safer on all types of courts.
C) It allows for quicker direction changes and is faster than running.
D) They are following a trend set by other sports.
questions.answer: C) It allows for quicker direction changes and is faster than running.

questions.question: Why has the speed of a tennis game increased lately?
options: A) Players have increased their training hours significantly.
B) Advances in racket materials and string technology have improved player performance.
C) The introduction of electronic scoring systems has sped up matches.
D) Players are now competing in shorter sets than before.
questions.answer: B) Advances in racket materials and string technology have improved player performance.

questions.question: What does a player need for an effective slide?
options: A) Experience with sliding techniques from other sports.
B) Shoes that perfectly match the court’s surface.
C) A warm-up routine to prepare their muscles.
D) A specific type of tennis ball for better grip.
questions.answer: B) Shoes that perfectly match the court’s surface.
